subject: Future Tech
title: Why Mars?
description: A quick, practical guide to Why Mars?.

hook.text: Mars is the most Earth-like planet we can reach. It has a 24.6-hour day, seasons, polar ice caps, and solid ground.

buildup.text: Its gravity is 38% of Earth's, enough to possibly support human health long-term, though no one has tested that.

discovery.text: Mars has water locked in ice at its poles and below the surface. That water is key to drinking, farming, and fuel.

twist.text: The atmosphere is 96% carbon dioxide with almost no oxygen. It's freezing, irradiated, and a vacuum to lungs.

climax.text: Despite the hostility, Mars is reachable in six to nine months. No other planet offers as much potential so close.

punchline.text: Mars is brutal, but it's the best option we have.
